conflicts.subject: HPU.discharge_pressure
conflicts.description: HPU.discharge_pressure normal_pressure: 180 applies to software < 3.2; 200 applies to software >= 3.2. The scopes are disjoint, so these are two correct values for different software revisions, not a contradiction.
conflicts.resolution: keep both; choose by the unit's software revision

conflicts.subject: HPU.discharge_pressure
conflicts.description: A field note reports about 175 bar, which matches neither normal setpoint ([180, 200] bar). The note's own caveats: uncalibrated gauge, unreviewed, undated, software revision not recorded, so it cannot be tied to either setpoint.
conflicts.resolution: do not adjudicate; the note cannot override manuals; a calibrated check would be needed

conflicts.subject: PLC-03.reset
conflicts.description: Manuals prohibit reset 'above 50 bar' and permit it only 'below 50 bar'; behaviour at exactly 50 bar is not stated. The firmware config blocks reset 'above' 50, which suggests exactly that value is allowed, but no document says so.
conflicts.resolution: treat as: do not reset above 50 bar; reset below 50 bar is explicitly permitted; the exact boundary value is unspecified

conflicts.subject: PLC-03
conflicts.description: Hydraulic schematic: the line PLC-03 - HPU is drawn in the colour the legend assigns to 'hydraulic fluid path', but one end is the controller, which carries signals, not fluid. The legend assigns control/signal connections to the purple lines only.
conflicts.resolution: report purple lines as the control/signal connections; flag this grey line as unexplained

conflicts.subject: HPU.discharge_pressure
conflicts.description: ECN-1042 justifies the 200 bar setpoint by benefit on 'Series-7 units manufactured after 2024', while the manuals scope 200 bar by software revision (3.2 and later) and PS-04A requires firmware >= 3.2. No source says whether older-built units that run revision >= 3.2 firmware use 200 bar, or whether newer-built units on older firmware may.
conflicts.resolution: best-supported reading: applicability follows the software revision (and PS-04A), not the build year; state the uncertainty

gaps.topic: Maximum continuous operating temperature of PS-04A
gaps.note: No document gives a temperature rating for PS-04A. Temperature mentions elsewhere are about other things.

gaps.topic: Calibration interval for a voltage sensor on the electrical system diagram
gaps.note: The electrical schematic shows no voltage sensor (only a 24VDC sensor-loop POWER SUPPLY and a pressure transducer loop reference), so the question's premise is not supported; and no source gives a calibration interval for any sensor (the PS-04A calibration record says none is specified).
ECN-1058's header lists number, title, effective date, references and status ('Released') but no approver or signature. 'Released' does not say who approved it.

gaps.topic: Mean time between failures (MTBF) of isolation valve IV-21
gaps.note: No reliability data for IV-21 (or any component) appears in the package.
Only 480V is mentioned (Q1 main disconnect 480V incoming; T1 480:120V control power). Nothing states the phase count or compatibility with 400V.

gaps.topic: Does the training slide deck introduce any alarm not in the manuals?
gaps.note: The slides contain no alarm codes.
